Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1465
Claimant:
Crystal Murphy
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
12-6-23
Claim opened for a side impact collision at an intersection, with the insured's vehicle struck on the driver side by a
vehicle that entered from the cross street. The claimant reports a shoulder injury and is represented by counsel, and
all correspondence will be routed thorugh the attorney's office.
12-27-23
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver involved is listed as a named driver with coverage in force at the time of
loss. No coverage issues identified at this stage.
2-9-24
Police report, scene photographs and two independent witness statements all line up with the account given by the
claimant and the other driver. The sequence of events appears consistent across every source collected so far.
3-14-24
Reviewed the damage estimate and photos. The vehicle damage is largely consistent with the described impact, with
the heaviest deformation on the driver side. Still need to confirm exactly where the claimant was seated, since the
accounts on this point are not fully clear.
4-18-24
A neighbor mentioned seeing the vehicle with damage several weeks before the reported loss date. Requested the
neighbor's contact details and will follow up, though this is a single secondhand observation and nothing else in the
file supports it yet. No earlier damage to the vehicle is recorded in our prior claims history.
5-13-24
Medical records show a shoulder injury with a treatment course that followed a typical pattern and eased off as the
claimant improved. No prior injury to the same area appears in the records obtained. The injury description fits the
type and force of this collision.
6-3-24
The claimant has gvien the same account in each conversation, including the recorded statement and subsequent
calls with counsel present. Based on the current file, the claim appears to be progressing normally, and I will keep the
neighbor follow-up open pending their statement.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
